cached_items.detail: Prove Inv by ingest/drain on an actual stored chat; boot cache then apply cached_items to establish this exact message in its room index. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

heldIn_index.detail: Same nonempty invariant store and boot cache; instantiate lookup/index equivalence at the actual stored chat id. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

have_shown.detail: Construct Inv and Cached for the nonempty held store, then apply have_shown to the filed chat path of an actual connection; no premise on the connection's past (rounds answer from the live index). Network.filedWitness separately establishes actual advertisement. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

write_cached.detail: Boot empty node/store, prove both initial invariants, then apply write_cached to a nonempty first chat write. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

purge_cached.detail: Nonempty stored chat and correct cache; purge names the shared chat. Shared ops are retained, so room cache remains valid. This complements separate local-secret deletion fixture. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

notice_sent.detail: Connection carries one actual stored leaf as a notice and no sync rooms. Construct nonempty notice, not-yet-given, unique room, keyed store and finite closure premises; actualNotice proves real output. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

notice_send.detail: Apply notice_send to an actual stored op emitted by the notice path, using actualNotice membership proof. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

notice_once.detail: Same nonempty notice is now recorded as given; prove every carried notice was given and apply notice_once to both handlers. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

notice_no_holds.detail: Receive nonempty encoded have on a connection carrying a notice only; prove decode and no sync-room premises, then get no send/take/store mutation. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

closure.detail: Finite nonempty stored leaf closure fits budget; apply closure completeness at the actual stored leaf to prove it is emitted. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

room_independent.detail: Known peer floor, a shown nonempty room index, and the room due (no round of it yet on the session); prove all premises and get the actual round message in send. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

unshown_room_answered.detail: A nonempty id claim for an unshown room returns an empty round-end message and unchanged connection. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

uncarried_room_answered.detail: Shown room receives a nonempty id claim; prove shown-room, nonempty-claim and accepted-epoch premises and derive the actual response head, answered from the live index. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

conn_answers_ids.detail: Actual shown-room index containing chat plus remote singleton item; prove allowed-room, accepted-epoch and live-index premises, then instantiate the exact exchange/connection response theorem. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

work_retry_bounded.detail: Connection has a real outstanding message id and retry due at 1500 ms; instantiate bound over the actual work handler. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

write_items.detail: The actual indexed chat (from cached_items) stays in the index across a repeated chat write turn, so live answers still read it. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

round_due.detail: A dialer connection with the peer's floor known, the room shown and no round of it yet, ticked at 100 ms on the nonempty held store: every premise proved, and the actual opening over the live index is in the tick's send. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

responder_asks.detail: A responder connection with the peer's floor known and the room shown with no round in it: every premise proved, and the actual empty have naming the room is in the tick's send. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

ask_due.detail: The dialer receives the responder's actual empty have for its shown room with no round in flight: the room is due afterwards and nothing is sent. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

join_round.detail: A dialer and a responder both showing the room, the responder with no round in it: its tick asks, the dialer hears it at 200 ms, and its tick at 300 ms opens the round; every premise proved on concrete connections. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

shown_due.detail: A connection showing no room starts showing the chat room: the room is due. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.

no_round_before_safety.detail: A dialer whose room's round opened at 50 ms, ticked at 100 ms with the 10-minute safety period: every premise proved, and no round message of the room is in the tick's send. Synthetic generic-family/held-store fixture; notice is a stored shared op, not a Community removal authorization proof.
